concept.hr: Izazov-odgovor ili karta; prelazak na NTLM; zašto pass-the-hash radi
concept.en: Challenge-response vs tickets; NTLM fallback; why pass-the-hash works

summary.hr: Po imenu Kerberos, po IP adresi NTLM. Promatrač dobiva izazov i odgovor; admin na PC07 uzima anin NT sažetak i prijavljuje se kao ana.
summary.en: By name Kerberos, by IP address NTLM. An observer gets challenge and response; an admin on PC07 takes ana's NT hash and logs on as ana.
